results.question: Olist 平台的客单价是多少？
results.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM olist_orders_dataset
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset USING(order_id)
results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset

results.question: Chinook 数据库总共有多少张发票？
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) AS invoice_count
FROM chinook.Invoice
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceId) AS invoice_count FROM chinook.Invoice

results.question: Olist 平台上有多少个活跃卖家？
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM olist_orders_dataset
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset USING(order_id)
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM olist_order_items_dataset

results.question: Chinook 有多少种不同的音乐流派？
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS genre_count FROM chinook.Genre

results.question: Olist 各支付方式各有多少笔？
results.sql:
SELECT olist_order_payments_dataset.payment_type AS payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_distribution
FROM olist_orders_dataset
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset USING(order_id)
GROUP BY olist_order_payments_dataset.payment_type
results.gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_distribution FROM olist_order_payments_dataset GROUP BY payment_type

results.question: 按支付类型展示交易笔数和平均支付金额
results.sql:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_value
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY count DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY count DESC

results.question: 按州比较 Olist 下单量和 Chinook 开票总数
results.sql:
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS olist_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chinook.Invoice) AS chinook_invoices
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY olist_orders DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS olist_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chinook.Invoice) AS chinook_invoices FROM olist_orders_dataset o JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY olist_orders DESC

results.question: 找出发货超期比例最高的 5 个商家，展示超期数、总订单项和比例
results.sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_sellers_dataset s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state
ORDER BY late_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi JOIN olist_sellers_dataset s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state ORDER BY late_pct DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Olist 评价数最多的 5 个品类是哪些？
results.gold_sql: SELECT t.product_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset r JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_name_english ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Chinook 曲目最多的 3 个流派是什么？
results.sql:
SELECT chinook.Genre.Name AS Genre, COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) AS track_count
FROM chinook.Track
JOIN chinook.Genre USING(GenreId)
GROUP BY chinook.Genre.Name
ORDER BY track_count DESC
LIMIT 3
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM chinook.Genre g JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 3
